ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast with approximately 70-80% high-intensity (white/cream) pixels in central lobe regions and 20-30% low-intensity (black) pixels along the trailing edges and perimeter.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central lobes exhibit contiguous high-intensity white zones with yellowish-tan gradients in the lower-central regions; low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous border along the trailing edge and outer margins; distinct dark vertical linear mark on the left lobe; multiple small dark punctate spots scattered across the white surface area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 35-40 degrees and a vertical depth roughly 1/5th of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks and valleys is higher on the medial edges of the notch and becomes more uniform toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading from the median notch to the tips; outer lateral margins show convex curvature rising from the water line.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Heavy colonization of high-intensity, roughly circular textured clusters (barnacles) forming a dense, raised secondary boundary along the distal tips and outer leading edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical dark linear disruption on the left lobe; several faint, unaligned vertical scratches visible on the inner portion of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the distal tips causing a ragged, irregular profile; visible dark linear scar/pigment mark on the mid-left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized yellowish-brown bio-fouling or pigmentation tinting concentrated in the lower quadrants of both lobes near the median notch.
